definitions.explanation: Hard, heat-resistant material made by firing non-metallic minerals. Used of modern engineered ceramics in knives, cookware, dental work, and electronics — not of traditional pottery, which is {陶器|とうき}.

examples.japanese: セラミック⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{包丁|ほうちょう}→包丁：04976_houchou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}っている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧セラミック⟦{加工|かこう}→加工：11793_kakou⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{焦|こ}げ{付|つ}き→焦げ付く：09452_kogetsuku⟧にくい。
examples.english: This pan has a ceramic coating, so food doesn't stick easily.

examples.japanese: {奥歯|おくば}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{金属|きんぞく}→金属：02645_kinzoku⟧⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧セラミック⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{詰|つ}め{物|もの}→詰め物：14365_tsumemono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んだ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: For the treatment of my back tooth, I chose a ceramic filling rather than a metal one.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- セラミック⟦{製|せい}→〜製：02001_sei⟧: made of ceramic
- セラミック⟦{加工|かこう}→加工：11793_kakou⟧: ceramic coating
- セラミック⟦ヒーター→ヒーター：05283_hiitaa⟧: ceramic heater
- ファインセラミックス: fine ceramics (the industrial-materials category, usually said in the plural)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{陶器|とうき}→陶器：14531_touki⟧: pottery, earthenware — traditional fired clay tableware
- ⟦{磁器|じき}→磁器：03335_jiki⟧: porcelain — the finer, whiter, vitrified kind
- ⟦{焼|や}き{物|もの}→焼き物：04974_yakimono⟧: ceramics, pottery — the craft and its products as a whole

Japanese takes セラミック as the modern technical word; a teacup is never described with it.
